title: Teaching Children to Cook
passage: Dear Dr. Lee, My husband seldom helps me in the kitchen and doesn't have any idea how to prepare a meal for himself. I have two sons, aged eight and four, that I worry about. I don't want them to be like their father. I hope they can be independent when I'm not around. Although they are still young and may make the kitchen dirty, I'd still like to teach them how to cook. When will they be old enough to use an oven and a kitchen knife? Worried Mom in Boston. Dear Worried Mom, Every man and woman should know how to cook a little. Your eight-year-old can start washing the vegetables and the dishes. He can put food in the oven and use a knife under close supervision. Your four-year-old should be able to set the table and help you clean up. They may make a mess in the kitchen, but they can also help clean it up. You can find lots of information about cooking for children at your local library and on the internet. Try to be more patient. Jason Lee.
